key_facts: Control may be affirmative or negative (e.g., a minority owner able to block a quorum); blocking only extraordinary actions (adding equity holders, dissolution, sale of all assets, merger, bankruptcy) is not negative control.

Common management (e); identity of interest (f) — family members doing business together presumed affiliated, rebuttable by a clear line of fracture; economic dependence presumed at 70% or more of receipts from one concern over three fiscal years.
Newly organized concern (g): former officers/key employees start a same-industry firm that gets contracts, financial or technical help from the old firm; rebuttable.
Joint ventures (h): partners not affiliated for contracts awarded within two years of the JV's first award; JV must be in writing and registered in SAM under its own name.
